sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Before the unit review, revisit the four building blocks from this unit: mennyi for price/amount, hány for countable items, ez/az for pointing things out, and quantity words like kiló, fél and negyed.
If you're unsure whether to use mennyi or hány, ask yourself: can I count it one by one? If yes, use hány; if it's a mass or a price, use mennyi.
